ideas.pitch: A localized predictive dashboard utilizing Poisson regression and rolling backtests to forecast municipal infrastructure strains and emergency incidents in Portage County.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven pattern of hard statistical engineering and forecasting seen in top hackathon wins, offering immediate civic utility for local stakeholders in Kent, Ohio.
